limitations: Entries labelled boulder by this source can be one physical boulder, a climb-specific unit, or a group. Never treat the 34 source sectors as 34 independently verified physical boulders.
Photographic viewpoint IDs are presentation units; orientations require evidence from independent photographs, coordinates, and field observations.

Thirty short original factual claim records summarize explicit route-page notes. They are unverified source claims, not field beta. The other 168 routes lack usable textual start/path claims on their public route page.
Authored route-path points, source descriptive prose, photo pixels, topo drawings, and user profiles are excluded.
This inventory is a current research workbench source index. Its existence does not imply permission to automate future acquisition or redistribute a source compilation.
